title: Without the Hot Air
summary: A free online book by David MacKay presenting scientifically rigorous, numbers-based analysis of sustainable energy options including wind, solar, nuclear, and fossil fuels, designed to cut through hype and misinformation with physics-based calculations.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of objective, quantitative analysis of sustainable energy feasibility and what it actually takes to power civilization.
why_valuable: Provides unbiased, physics-grounded education that helps readers understand energy numbers without political bias or hype, making complex energy debates accessible.
